notes.title: Difficulty Selection, New Mode, and a New Steam Achievement Updated
notes.content:
There were cases which players wanted to enjoy game's story, but failed due to the game's high difficulty.
So we decided to fix the game level by adding Difficulty Selection UI on main title screen, and ESC menu.
Three difficulties are updated, including Normal, the existing difficulty.

[list]
[*] Easy
[/list]
Lose 7 cards on collision
Shuffle - Reload 5 cards at once
Card Throwing - Card Knockback increased
[list]
[*] Normal
[/list]
Lose 7 cards on collision
Shuffle - Reload 3 cards at once
[list]
[*] Blind
[/list]
In addition to Normal difficulty,
Magician's Mind Reading (Pattern UIs of staff) is removed
There are no change in scripts or ending

------------------------------------------------------

Blind mode is a slightly more difficult version than Normal.
As the staff's behavior pattern UI disappears, players need to intuitively identify and respond to their pattern / timing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39876197/44a2e2a07902aaed8fbf3621b434db21862b0156.png[/img]

And with this new mode, a new steam achievement has been updated.

[list]
[*] A Master of Magic
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39876197/1a465b37b988060f9d200c9bc08fe19f2b2f0415.png[/img]

To earn this achievement, players must clear all floors in Blind mode and reach the ending credits.
The floors don't have to be cleared in right order, and there is no problem if player exit the game while playing.
However, if the cheat mode is enabled, that floor will not be counted.
Make sure to press ESC before starting the challenge to make sure the cheat is off.

+) Clear data of the floor is saved when you finish hacking the computer and move on to the next floor.
++) You should also clear floors where only NPCs exist without computer. However, you can skip all conversations as much as you want.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39876197/2f5f10706f9aba0a7986ed8f0237ea7f5152a39e.png[/img]

notes.title: English Translation Update
notes.content:
2021/02/28 
English translation of Three of Cards has been updated.
You can turn on English mode by clicking on the paper joker button in main title or ESC menu.
The translations are not imperfect yet, but I hope everyone would enjoy it.
Feedbacks and reports about errors in translation are always welcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39876197/890581c383549572727574cdcfa4039c5ebbbf26.png[/img]
